"""Package existing and new local evidence; never runs performance workloads."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import statistics
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PRIOR = ROOT / 'docs/reports/macos-arm64-2026-10-18-spatial-sme-optimization.json'
CONTROL = ROOT / 'docs/reports/macos-arm64-2026-10-18-panel-store-pipeline-analysis.json'
REPORT = ROOT / 'docs/macos-spatial-sme-pipeline-analysis.md'
EVIDENCE = ROOT / 'docs/reports/macos-arm64-2026-10-18-spatial-sme-pipeline-analysis.json'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
old = json.loads(PRIOR.read_text())
new = json.loads((OUT / 'new-measurements.json').read_text())
control = json.loads(CONTROL.read_text())
reused = {(c['model'], c['fixture']): c['after'] for c in old['profiles']['cases']}
profiles = dict(reused)
profiles.update({(c['model'], c['fixture']): c for c in new['new_profiles']})
controls = {(c['model'], c['fixture']): c['profile'] for c in control['cases']}
pages = {'imgs_1': 'sparse', 'imgs_00018069': 'dense', 'imgs_00006737': 'mixed'}
phases = ['det_preprocess_ns', 'det_inference_ns', 'det_postprocess_ns', 'crop_ns',
          'classification_wall_ns', 'recognition_wall_ns']
cases = []
for c in old['comparison']['cases']:
    key = c['model'], c['fixture']
    p = profiles[key]
    s = p['profile']
    assert p['complete_owned_outputs_exactly_equal']
    assert p['control_output_sha256'] == controls[key]['control_output_sha256']
    assert p['recognized_lines'] == len(c['after']['result']['lines'])
    assert sum(s[k] for k in phases) <= s['total_ns']
    owners = s['recognition_owners'][:s['recognition_owner_count']]
    cases.append(dict(model=c['model'], fixture=c['fixture'], page_label=pages[c['fixture']],
        page_origin=str(PRIOR.relative_to(ROOT)) + ':comparison.cases.after',
        job=c['job'], page=c['after'],
        profile_origin=('reused: ' + str(PRIOR.relative_to(ROOT)) + ':profiles.cases.after'
                        if key in reused else 'new: run.py, one warm-up and one instrumented call'),
        profile=p, complete_output_hash_matches_pre_spatial_control=True,
        derived=dict(warm_median_ms=statistics.median(c['after']['samples_ms']),
            phase_share_percent={k: 100*s[k]/s['total_ns'] for k in phases},
            unassigned_outer_wall_ms=(s['total_ns']-sum(s[k] for k in phases))/1e6,
            projection_share_of_backbone_plus_projection_work_percent=
                100*s['projection_ns']/(s['rec_backbone_ns']+s['projection_ns']),
            owner_finish_range_ms=[min(o['dispatch_end_offset_ns'] for o in owners)/1e6,
                                   max(o['dispatch_end_offset_ns'] for o in owners)/1e6])))

def table(headers, rows):
    return '\n'.join(['| ' + ' | '.join(headers) + ' |',
                      '| ' + ' | '.join(['---'] * len(headers)) + ' |'] +
                     ['| ' + ' | '.join(str(x) for x in row) + ' |' for row in rows])

def label(c):
    return c['model'].title() + ' / ' + c['page_label']

ordinary = table(['Bundle / page', 'Lines', 'Warm median ms', 'Range ms', 'First call ms'], [
    [label(c), c['profile']['recognized_lines'], f"{c['derived']['warm_median_ms']:.2f}",
     f"{min(c['page']['samples_ms']):.2f}–{max(c['page']['samples_ms']):.2f}",
     f"{c['page']['first_inference_ms']:.2f}"] for c in cases])
wall = table(['Bundle / page', 'DET prep', 'DET network', 'DB boxes', 'Crop', 'CLS + rotation', 'REC + assembly', 'Total'], [
    [label(c)] + [f"{c['profile']['profile'][k]/1e6:.2f}" for k in phases + ['total_ns']] for c in cases])
cls = table(['Bundle / page', 'CLS resize', 'CLS backbone', 'Two-class head', '180° rotation', 'Rotated lines'], [
    [label(c)] + [f"{c['profile']['profile'][k]/1e6:.4f}" for k in
                 ['cls_preprocess_ns','cls_backbone_ns','cls_head_ns','cls_rotation_ns']] +
    [c['profile']['applied_180_rotations']] for c in cases])
rec = table(['Bundle / page', 'REC resize', 'REC backbone', 'Projection', 'CTC'], [
    [label(c)] + [f"{c['profile']['profile'][k]/1e6:.4f}" for k in
                 ['rec_preprocess_ns','rec_backbone_ns','projection_ns','ctc_ns']] for c in cases])
overheads = table(['Bundle / page', 'Binding', 'DET + REC reshape', 'Result storage', 'Owned copy'], [
    [label(c)] + [f"{c['profile']['profile'][k]/1e6:.4f}" for k in
                 ['binding_ns','reshape_ns','result_storage_ns']] +
    [f"{c['profile']['owned_conversion_ns']/1e6:.4f}"] for c in cases])
operators = table(['Fused probe', 'Step sum ms', '1×1 conv ms', '1×1 share', 'Layout conversion ms'], [
    [p['model'].title() + (' DET sparse / 8 threads' if p['kind']=='detector' else
                           f" REC width {p['shape'][-1]} / 1 thread"),
     f"{p['total_step_ms']:.3f}", f"{p['groups_ms']['Conv 1x1 groups=1']:.3f}",
     f"{100*p['groups_ms']['Conv 1x1 groups=1']/p['total_step_ms']:.1f}%",
     f"{p['groups_ms'].get('Convert',0):.4f}"] for p in new['new_operators']])
owner_rows = []
for c in cases:
    if c['page_label'] == 'sparse':
        continue
    s=c['profile']['profile']; owners=s['recognition_owners'][:s['recognition_owner_count']]
